title: 人工濕地水質淨化
summary: 以「水力停留、氧化還原與季節性淨化」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow hydraulic residence, redox and seasonal treatment through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 負荷與功能定位：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Load and treatment function: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 負荷與功能定位 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Load and treatment function and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 人工濕地是受水力與污染負荷限制的處理單元；面積綠化不能直接代表淨化能力。
steps.instructionEn: A treatment wetland is constrained by hydraulic and pollutant loading; green area alone does not establish treatment capacity.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：organic load=Q C/1000;Q=100 m3/day;C=80 mg/L；計算 100*80/1000 = 8 kg/day。適用限制：進料BOD示例，不預設去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: organic load=Q C/1000;Q=100 m3/day;C=80 mg/L; calculation 100*80/1000 = 8 kg/day. Applicability: Illustrative influent BOD load without assumed removal.
steps.failure: 只依面積比例增加進水可能超出氧與水力能力。
steps.failureEn: Increasing feed by area ratio alone can exceed oxygen or hydraulic capacity.
steps.check: 保持濃度，將流量加倍比較負荷。
steps.checkEn: Keep concentration fixed and double flow to compare loading.
